objective: Test whether a stage-generic runtime release at the shared stage-log wrapper return (0x14078ff03) lets the real Setup verification chain advance past Setup.SP_Verify_GetServerOption/GetNotice into the remaining stages (CardLogin/IsLogin/SaveConfig/StoredAuthorizationUsableAfterSave), and observe what the sample subsequently does.
hypothesis: The virtualized Setup driver carries each stage return code in a callee-saved register (observed rbx=fffffffd at site 0x142037706 in run 24) across the shared log-wrapper call; the wrapper epilogue restores that register before ret, so zeroing eax/ebx at the fixed wrapper ret 0x14078ff03 after a logged failure makes the driver treat the stage as successful.
discriminator: chain advances (new stage tags beyond GetNotice, e.g. CardLogin/IsLogin/SaveConfig/StoredAuthorizationUsableAfterSave) vs chain stalls at GetNotice or earlier (no new tags).
changed_variable_vs_run24: single-site one-time force at 0x142037706 replaced by conditional stage-generic force at shared wrapper ret 0x14078ff03; message-box skip family extended; FatalExit changed from skip to observer-only.
observation_mode: attach-after-launch (CDB attaches natural EPT_* temp child started by parent C:/ept_core/Hardware.exe under SYSTEM scheduled task)
acceptance: stage log captured with original codes per stage (STAGE_LOG lines)
presence/absence of stage tags beyond GetNotice recorded
every forced stage marked FORCED_ZERO with the forcing site fixed at 0x14078ff03
no response injection, no card value fabrication, in-memory writes only
data_adapter: Copy-Item ToSession/FromSession over the same PSSession
writer_lock: exclusive scheduled task name EPT-EPT-AUTHGATE-20260925-26; prep kills leftover Hardware/EPT_/cdb processes; single operator session
instrument_canary: canary_syntax.cdb run against benign cmd.exe before task registration; task not registered unless all markers present and no Syntax error
timeout_action: host kills cdb at harvest; run classified INCONCLUSIVE if no stage evidence
